samples.question: A dark horizontal reference bar is drawn inside the grey box at the top of the image. The thickness of a bar is how tall it is: the vertical extent between its top edge and its bottom edge. Below the box the image is split by thin lines into four quadrants (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right), each containing one dark horizontal bar. Exactly one quadrant's bar has the SAME thickness as the reference bar; the other three bars each have a clearly different thickness. Which quadrant contains the bar whose thickness matches the reference bar? Answer with one quadrant name.
